title: HarborDeck quota snapshot
description: <HARBORDECK_HOME>/quota.json. Optional. One stamina bar per usage window: what is left (100 - used_pct) and when it resets.

model.description: Set on a per-model window (only that model's usage counts); absent on account windows.

at.description: When this reading was taken (epoch seconds). Default: the file's modification time.

runs_out_at.description: Projected exhaustion at the current pace (epoch seconds), when it comes before resets_at.
